meta.name: deck-xhs-white
meta.description: 纯白 + 顶部彩虹 bar + 渐变文字 + 马卡龙软卡片 + 黑底 pill

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格的纯白彩虹渐变卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作小红书风格的纯白彩虹渐变卡片。
copy.tagline_en: Generate Xiaohongshu-style white rainbow gradient cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create Xiaohongshu-style white rainbow gradient cards.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按白底杂志风排版内容：纯白背景加顶部 10 色彩虹条，标题用紫蓝绿橙粉渐变大字，配马卡龙色软卡片，重点句做成黑底白字 pill。同一版面可发小红书图文，也能当横版 PPT 用。
howto.when: 当你要做小红书图文或横版 PPT，并想要白底杂志风版面时使用。比例按 16:9 或 3:4。

say.text: 用白底杂志风做一版小红书图文，标题用渐变字
say.note: 输出纯白底加顶部彩虹条的版面

say.text: 把这份内容排成 16:9 横版 PPT，卡片用马卡龙色
say.note: 按横版比例生成卡片组

say.text: 给这页加黑底白字的 focus pill 和大块引用
say.note: 重点句做成黑底白字 pill

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude lays out content in a white editorial style: pure white background with a 10-color rainbow bar on top, gradient display headings, macaron soft cards, and black-on-white pills for key lines. The same layout works for Xiaohongshu image posts and landscape slides.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a white editorial layout for a Xiaohongshu image post or a landscape deck. Aspect ratio is 16:9 or 3:4.

say_en.text: Make a Xiaohongshu image post in white editorial style, gradient title
say_en.note: Outputs a pure white layout with a top rainbow bar

say_en.text: Lay this content out as a 16:9 landscape deck with macaron cards
say_en.note: Generates card groups at landscape ratio

say_en.text: Add a black-on-white focus pill and a large quote block to this page
